introduction: Hercules Ventures Into the World is a follow-up of the 2004’ documentary entitled HERCULES shot by Lidia Duda in Bytom, Poland, in the poorest district of the city. It pictured the Sawczuk family, the jobless from many years, who try to earn something picking scrap-iron or coal out. It appeared, however, that it has been the 11 year old Krzysiek – Hercules as he is called by the father – who makes ends meet.Moved by a history of the boy, as the documentary was broadcast at TVP2, a young couple from Warsaw decides to take him on vacations to Warsaw and a seaside. The camera follows its hero there to observe his reactions as he goes out of the world he knew till now.
